results.sql: SELECT SUM(nbrx) AS total_nbrx FROM v_hcp_rx WHERE is_ours = FALSE LIMIT 500
SELECT state, SUM(trx) AS trx FROM v_hcp_rx WHERE is_ours = TRUE GROUP BY state ORDER BY trx DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(vae_sent) AS total_vae_sent FROM v_hcp_activity LIMIT 500
SELECT territory_id, SUM(calls) AS total_calls FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY territory_id LIMIT 500
SELECT payer_name, COUNT(*) AS abandoned_claims FROM v_payer_access WHERE is_ours = TRUE GROUP BY payer_name ORDER BY abandoned_claims DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT channel, SUM(submitted) AS total_submitted FROM v_payer_access GROUP BY channel LIMIT 500
SELECT hcp_id, SUM(nbrx) AS nbrx FROM v_hcp_rx WHERE is_ours = TRUE AND week_start > CAST('2025-12-29' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '91' DAY GROUP BY hcp_id ORDER BY nbrx DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT rep_id FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY rep_id HAVING SUM(calls) > 150) LIMIT 500
SELECT specialty, SUM(vae_sent) AS vae_sent, SUM(vae_opened) AS vae_opened FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY specialty LIMIT 500
SELECT month, SUM(trx) AS trx FROM v_hcp_rx WHERE is_ours = TRUE GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 500
